result.title: LipLingo: CNN Model for Lip Reading
result.summary: Lip reading plays a crucial role in applications such as speech recognition, assistive technologies for the hearing-impaired, and biometric authentication. However, performance often degrades when the speaker varies and when certain speech sounds are visually similar. To address these challenges, we propose LipLingo, a robust lip-reading system based on the LipNet architecture, enhanced with a standardized preprocessing pipeline for consistent mouth-region representation, a rotational validation strategy for improved generalization to unseen speakers, and a flexible similarity evaluation for more reliable sentence-level assessment. The model architecture combines 3D convolutional layers for spatio-temporal feature extraction and bidirectional recurrent layers for sequence modeling, optimized using the Adam optimizer and Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) loss. On the GRID dataset, LipLingo achieved 95.0\% character-level accuracy (CER 4.99\%) and 87.2\% sentence-level accuracy. At the corpus level, the system obtained a (WER 13.1\%), outperforming the baseline LipNet and demonstrating competitive performance relative to recent 3D-ResNet + Bi-GRU + MixUp approaches. These results provide insights into strategies that enhance lip-reading robustness and highlight directions for future work toward real-world deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LipLingo 唇读系统，在 LipNet 基础上加入统一口部区域预处理、轮换验证策略与灵活相似度评估，用 3D 卷积加双向循环层和 CTC 训练，并在 GRID 上报告字符与句子级准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 属唇读序列识别与刷分工作，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选或推理期计算决策，其预处理与验证策略仅为通用工程改进，缺少可供核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
